scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.api:check: pnpm run api:codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client-react/src/generated packages/api-zod/src/generated
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present --filter "!@workspace/admin" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
